Our story

About Us

Saffron & Sage is a seasonal neighbourhood kitchen serving honest, flavourful food.

Our Vision

To be the neighbourhood table where the seasons set the menu and every guest feels at home.

Our Mission

  • Cook honestly: a handful of good ingredients, prepared well over open fire.
  • Buy locally: produce from nearby farms, with the menu changing with the market.
  • Welcome everyone: generous, warm hospitality, whether for a quick lunch or a long dinner with friends.

Saffron & Sage

Seasonal kitchen, honest flavours. Walk-ins welcome — reservations recommended at weekends.
